text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000018 bills 99215 far above expectation in every complexity band, yet the few documented 99215 claims all support the billed level, so upcoding and a sicker-than-captured panel cannot be told apart.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The 99215 share is elevated within every condition-count band, not only among complex patients. Low-complexity examples include 99215 claims on patients with no chronic conditions billed only for back pain, abdominal pain or a follow-up code (C0008337, C0008475, C0008883, C0008934), which is the pattern most consistent with upcoding. Against that, all 8 documented 99215 claims were supported, with high MDM and recorded times in the 40s on C0008675, C0008680 and C0008958. However, 8 charts is too thin to clear a pattern this large, and documentation can be templated to match the billed level. The 3 notes claiming moderate-plus data review with no lab or test line, and the two 99214 claims documented at low MDM (C0008403, C0008562), are weak signals only, not proof of inflated notes. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed above and check whether their MDM narrative reflects the visit, rather than relying on more records from complex patients."}
